package rulefixtures

import (
	"database/sql"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for gin_handler_starts_transaction_inline: Handlers that create or own transactions instead of delegating transactional work to services or unit-of-work helpers.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: warning.
type Rule050PositiveRecord struct {
	db *sql.DB
}

func scenario050Positive(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, repo Rule050PositiveRecord) error {
	tx, err := repo.db.Begin()
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "failed to begin transaction", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return err
	}
	defer tx.Rollback()

	_, err = tx.ExecContext(r.Context(), "UPDATE accounts SET balance = balance - 10 WHERE id = ?", 1)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "update failed", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return err
	}

	if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "commit failed", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return err
	}
	return nil
}
